description:
FILED s540b (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-13), docs/speed-low-hanging-review-s540.md part 1 (the registry table).  Code sha 05806e16.

MEASUREMENT TAKEN (scratch/s540b/optdiff.pl: for each Pl::Passes name, which of tools/bench-exec.pl's 75 rows' emission changes under PCL_OPT=-NAME; scratch/s540b/optab.pl: those rows timed default vs -NAME, startup subtracted, interleaved best of 3; legs/leg3.log + leg5.log, quiet box):
  elem-setf          2 rows: arrhash +3.3 %, tiehash -4.0 %
  raw-return-family  6 timed: subret -1.2, methret -4.9, methinh +0.2, methpoly -1.3, moo-objs -2.0, localvar +0.9
  insensitive-call   3 rows: subret +4.0, sigarith +3.7, localvar +1.3  (one bind is ~4 ns: docs part 1 P3)
  raw-block-eval     0 rows change
  raw-closure-capture 0 rows change
For contrast, nine names hold 10-425 % on their rows (sig-classic +425, classic-sort +341/373, foreach-arrays +95..337, symref-const +136, list-decl-split +99, local-push +80, numeric-slot +18..60, foreach-raw +40, tail-return +10..23, args-copy +10).

WHAT IS OWED (cheap): (1) `tools/corpus-diff.pl`-style emission counts of each name over the everyday corpus + the four review modules (how many forms change -- zero means the licence never fires on real code either); (2) for each name with forms that change, the everyday programs / a module-heavy bench row (json-rt, moo-objs) A/B'd with the name off, best of 5 with a base-vs-base column.  A name that changes no real form and no measurable time is a deletion candidate (the s411 registry rule: a transform must name what it buys).

DO NOT: delete on the bench evidence alone -- raw-return-family and insensitive-call LICENSE other verdicts (a raw slot downstream, a bind removed) and the bench rows were never written for them; dyn-loop-exit / fh-scope-close / line-track are semantics switches, not speed.
subject: MEASURE BEFORE DELETING (s540b): five optimization-registry names hold NOTHING measurable on the bench rows -- `elem-setf`, `raw-return-family`, `insensitive-call` (within +-5 % with the name off) and `raw-block-eval`, `raw-closure-capture` (no bench row's emission changes at all); measure them on real code, then keep, re-bench or delete each
